newsitem.title: CHINA: First Shanghai-HK direct rail service starts.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai-HK direct rail service starts.

text.p: The first direct train from Shanghai to Hong Kong left Shanghai's station on Monday, a new service intended by China to strengthen ties with the territory it takes back on July 1.
The service will operate every two days, with the rail journey taking 29 hours.
The first direct train service between Beijing and Hong Kong was inaugurated on Sunday.
Previously, passengers travelling by train to Hong Kong from either city had to change trains in Guangzhou or in Shenzhen on the border with Hong Kong.
After more than 150 years as a British colony, Hong Kong is to become a Special Administrative Region of China.
